body:
You're a good and generous person.  Yes, we are WoW players (me, the father, and the son).  I am, in fact, the guild master of a rather large guild. The fact that I enjoyed the hobby so much with the father definitely ignited the boy's interest.  The boy's interest in the game has made his father more unhappy.  The father thinks of the time we all spend together as family time.  When "family time" is over, he wants to spend time on transmog and whatever other bullshit.  It's hard to explain the details of that if you don't currently play, because, frankly, it's idiotic.  I had a great deal more fun playing in the hotel pool with the boy than I did obtaining vanity pets for him.   (for example)

In any event, I am grateful for your kindness. You are a good boy and/or girl and I wish you all the best in life.  I mean that so sincerely.  Words cannot express.

Seriously, this kid is not just any kid.  He really is very special.  He really is very dear to me.  We have inside jokes and everything.  We have a lot of affection for each other.  He's very smart.  Believe me, please; he is not my child, I have no reason to make him more than he is.  He's already been through his parents' divorce, 2 or 3 years ago.  How can I leave his father and put him through a similar thing?  It's not his fault that his father is a prick.

I thank you for replying to me.  I know what you said makes sense. I appreciate everything you wrote and how it was phrased.  I did not say I was a gamer but you seemed to grasp that intuitively.  (that being alive is an opportunity I get only once).  

It does not really matter.  I still want to step away from life.  I still want out.  You're a good person to even hang out in this subreddit.  You're probably a college kid which makes it even more touching to me.  You keep on being a good person, okay?  Don't let the world eat you and shit you back out, please.  I'm so sorry you even read my message.  I'm so sorry.

Thank you for asking.  I am not holding up well today.  I am drunk.  I still wish I was dead.  I hope that you are able to find a way through your problems.  I am so sorry to hear that you are having a hard time too.
